name: James
summary: A fisherman, the son of Zebedee and brother of John, who left his nets to follow Jesus. He was one of the three disciples Jesus often took with Him, and was later killed by King Herod.

key_moments.title: Leaving the Nets
key_moments.description: Jesus saw James and his brother John in a boat with their father Zebedee, mending their nets. When Jesus called them, they left the boat and their father and followed Him.

key_moments.title: Chosen and Named a Son of Thunder
key_moments.description: Jesus chose twelve to be with Him and to preach. He gave James and John the name Boanerges, which means sons of thunder.

key_moments.title: Sees Jesus Changed on the Mountain
key_moments.description: Jesus took Peter, James and John up a high mountain, and was changed before them. His clothes shone white, Elijah and Moses appeared, and a voice from a cloud spoke about Him.

key_moments.title: Asking for the Best Seats
key_moments.description: James and John asked to sit at Jesus' right and left hand in His glory. Jesus said whoever wants to be great must serve, for He came to serve and give His life.

key_moments.title: Killed by Herod
key_moments.description: King Herod began to harm some in the church, and he killed John's brother James with the sword.
